name: West Chester (United States)
description: Blue field with six yellow ribbons — four rising diagonally and two vertical — crossing to form a grid, for the six original streets of Market, Gay, High, Chestnut, Walnut and Church.
history: West Chester is the county seat of Chester County, Pennsylvania. The flag was chosen in a contest sponsored by the local business The Fence Authority and its founder John DiGiuseppe and officially adopted by the borough council on 20 March 2019; its six gold ribbons represent the six original streets.

features.role: six ribbons forming a grid, for the six original streets
